calendar.meta.title: Race calendar
calendar.meta.description: Every round of {season}: circuits, start times in German time, sprint weekends and status – with a calendar subscription for your phone.
calendar.title: Race calendar
calendar.lead: Every race with circuit, date and start time. Times are German time (Europe/Berlin); if your time zone differs, we show your local time as well.
calendar.subscribe.title: Subscribe to the calendar
calendar.subscribe.text: Subscribe once and every race lands in your calendar automatically – including later changes and cancellations.
calendar.subscribe.dstNote: Events are stored with their time zone (Europe/Berlin). Summer and winter time changes are taken into account, and your calendar app converts them to your own time zone automatically.
calendar.subscribe.howtoApple: iPhone, iPad and Mac: tap “Subscribe to calendar” – the Calendar app will ask whether you want to add the subscription.
calendar.subscribe.howtoGoogle: Google Calendar: copy the subscription address, then on a computer choose “Other calendars” → “From URL” and paste it in.
calendar.subscribe.howtoOutlook: Outlook: choose “Add calendar” → “Subscribe from web” and paste the subscription address.
calendar.subscribe.includes: Includes the current season and any seasons already scheduled.
calendar.next.title: Next round
calendar.upcoming.title: Upcoming rounds
calendar.planned.title: Preview: {season}
calendar.planned.lead: Next season’s calendar is already set. Dates may still change before the season starts.
calendar.empty.title: The calendar is being planned
calendar.empty.text: As soon as the dates are confirmed you’ll find them here. Until then, all the news is on Discord.
calendar.none.upcoming: There are no races left this season.
calendar.round.cancelledNote: Cancelled – this round will not take place.
calendar.round.sprintHint: Sprint weekend with qualifying, sprint and race
calendar.ics.name: {league} – race calendar
calendar.ics.description: Every race of {league}, online league for {game}. Times in Europe/Berlin.
calendar.race.metaDescription: {round} ({season}) on {date}: line-up, qualifying, race result, stewards’ decisions and videos.
calendar.race.countdownOver: The race is on or has just finished – the result will follow shortly.
calendar.banner.provisional: Provisional result. Protests can be lodged until {deadline}.
calendar.banner.provisionalNoDeadline: Provisional result. The stewards are still reviewing.
calendar.banner.provisionalClosed: Provisional result. The protest window has closed and the stewards are ruling on open reports.
calendar.banner.cancelled: This round has been cancelled and does not count towards the championship.
calendar.banner.lineup: The line-up is set. The provisional result will appear shortly after the race.
calendar.banner.awaiting: The race has been run – the result is being entered.
calendar.lineup.emptyText: The admins take all absences into account and publish the line-up no later than 24 hours before the start.
calendar.lineup.cancelledText: There is no line-up for cancelled rounds.
calendar.lineup.expectedTitle: Regular line-up according to the seat plan
calendar.lineup.expectedNote: Without absences or stand-ins – only the published line-up is binding.

calendar.stewards.title: Stewards’ decisions

calendar.stewards.reportOpen: Saw an incident? Reports can be submitted until {deadline}.

calendar.media.emptyText: Once the recording, highlights or race report are online, you’ll find them here.
calendar.nav.label: More rounds
calendar.results.meta.title: Results
calendar.results.meta.description: Every race result of {season}: winner, pole position and fastest lap for each round – plus results from previous seasons.
calendar.results.title: Results
calendar.results.lead: Winner, pole and fastest lap of every round at a glance. Select a round for the full result of every session.
calendar.results.earlier.title: Previous seasons
calendar.results.earlier.lead: Every race from past seasons with its winner – one click takes you to the full result.
calendar.results.noneText: After the first race of the season you’ll find the winner, pole and fastest lap here.
